title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from above at an angle. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left square; a gold disc marks the goal on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons (or arrow keys) move the token one square. Hint shows a green arrow on a move that brings the token one step closer. Readouts give moves made and steps still to the goal.

game.objective: Move the blue token to the gold goal square in as few moves as you can. The shortest route takes 4 moves.
game.hint: The token moves only up, down, left or right, so the steps to the goal are the rows plus the columns between them. Press Hint to see a good move.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up means toward the far side of the board as seen from the starting camera. The hint arrow shows one good move and disappears after your next move.
